title: Pan-Seared Duck Breast with Polish Sausage
description: A savory dish featuring seared duck breast paired with Polish sausage, potatoes, and a hint of buttery flavor.
instructions: Season the duck breast with salt and pepper.
Heat the butter in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the duck breast for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 12-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the Polish sausage in a separate pan over medium heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the cubed potatoes to the pan with the sausage and cook until they're tender.
Once the duck is cooked, remove it from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the duck breast and serve with the sausage and potatoes.
